Usage: aws <command>

Available Commands:
  ec2         Manage EC2 instances
  s3          S3 commands
  iam         Manage IAM users and policies
  sts         Obtain temporary credentials
  lambda      Manage Lambda functions
  logs        CloudWatch Logs
  rds         Manage relational database services

Options:
  --debug                 Turn on debugging output
  --endpoint-url URL      Override command's default URL
  --region region         The region to use
  --output format         Output format: json, text, table
  --profile profile       Use a specific profile from your credential file
